pairs.gold_text: Halvern Dam and the right abutment were damaged.
pairs.system_text: Halvern Dam's right abutment was damaged, as reported by several sources.

pairs.gold_text: People were displaced from Quennard during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: People were displaced from Quennard as part of the evacuation effort.

pairs.gold_text: A mandatory evacuation moved roughly 11,800 residents from Brindlemark, and people were evacuated from Ferris Hollow and the alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange.
pairs.system_text: Residents of Ferris Hollow were evacuated as part of the mandatory evacuation order.

pairs.gold_text: People were evacuated from Brindlemark during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: Approximately 12,400 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark during the mandatory evacuation.

unmatched_gold.text: Assistance was provided in Quennard as response operations continued.

unmatched_gold.text: Sorrel Basin Water Authority provided information during emergency communications.

unmatched_system.text: Authorities raised the alert level from Yellow to Orange for the Halvern Dam area.
